I have a toddler, I need a no-slip option for the tub. I searched, for a good option that was also cost effective. I didn't want a mat - to me, they are too thick and get grimmey/slimey around the suction cups. This was a fun print that is also a good alternative. I had to buy 2 packs (I bought 1 turtle and 1 penguin pack) so there would be enough to fit my standard sized tub.  Pros: The colors are vibrant and don't quickly fade (I am writing this review almost 2 months after purchase/install...
These tub stickers are great!  It took four sets to get my tub to be safe for my toddler, but we have fun counting the different animals.

reviews.t: These things are TINY!!! Better buy 2 or 3 packs!

We have used these for the past three years to make the slippery bottom of the tub safer for the kids. After about two years (of daily baths and showers) some of the stickers started falling off and had to be replaced but I feel we definately got our moneys worth with that amount of time! They work great!

While the stickers themselves are adorable they are actually pretty slick and don't keep me or my child from sliding around.  The bottom of my tub came with a better non-slip tread than these stickers have.  I would recommend these more for decorating the side of the tub rather than using them as a non-slip pad.

claims.text: Customers find the stickers cute and fun, often mentioning the animal designs.
Many reviewers say they work well for making the tub non-slip and safer for kids or after surgery.
Several customers note the stickers are small and that one pack is not enough, so you need to buy two or more packs to cover a tub.
Installation requires a dry tub and a waiting period (e.g., 8–24 hours) before getting them wet, which some find inconvenient.
A few reviewers report durability issues, with some stickers falling off after about two years, while others note they stick well.
